name: gloam
description: Private stablecoin payments for agents on Tempo: pay x402 and MPP resources, shield, get paid, with onchain spending limits.

interface.shortDescription: Private stablecoin payments for agents on Tempo
interface.longDescription: Pay for x402 and MPP resources, hold a shielded balance and get paid, privately, on Tempo testnet. The owner's wallet authorizes a Tempo access key with a spending limit, an expiry and call scopes that the protocol enforces, so the caps hold even if the agent is tricked or its host is compromised.
defaultPrompt: Set up Gloam with a 10 PathUSD a day limit on my Tempo account.
Fetch this paid URL and pay for it privately if it asks for a Gloam payment.
How much can the agent still spend today, and what has it paid?
